name: Legacy Inno registry probes reject instrument failures
command:
bash -n bin/lib/inno-legacy-reaper.selftest.sh
BASH_XTRACEFD=3 timeout 600 bash -x bin/lib/inno-legacy-reaper.selftest.sh 3> "$HOME/.papercusp/scratch/c0523-inno-legacy-registry-v3.trace" > "$HOME/.papercusp/scratch/c0523-inno-legacy-registry-v3.log" 2>&1
summary: The maintained shell test passed exact present/absent-key/absent-key-or-value, denied, timeout, unreadable-success and wrong-key controls, existing lifecycle controls, and real quoted/unquoted ghost/live Inno cases; no SKIP. Local scoped verification only; full aggregate and plan shipment remain unmeasured.

assertions.evidence: Actual key_exists, seed precondition and ghost assertion reject denied access, timeout even with absence text, unreadable success and wrong-key output. Both Wine and key-or-value absence diagnostics pass only on exit1.
Confirmed missing live key and surviving ghost key set RC=1; instrument failures terminate with case measured nothing and never emit ghost reaped or GHOST NOT REAPED.
Existing maintained negative controls reject nonpersistent Wine server and failed wait; positive control checks one display across clients and scoped shutdown/wait.
Original v3 native log: [quoted] ghost reaped and live entry spared.
Original v3 native log: [unquoted] ghost reaped and live entry spared; terminal PASS, native exit0, no skip.

nativeExecution.timestampScope: Enclosing native exec batch start through terminal result readback; not a child-wall performance measurement.

historicalAttempt.reason: Initial classifier refused Wine confirmed-absence wording; output preserved and corrected in v3. No product-failure claim.

referencePathConvention: Home references use ~ or $HOME; original native logs remain unchanged.
